title: Servex: a process monitor, RAM and CPU per task

message.text:
Plan: /framework/ai/2026-09-30/process-monitor/plan.md.
1. Servex records every claude.exe's PID when it spawns it. One sampler reads RAM and CPU for every process every 10 s, split into ours vs. everything else, and by task.
2. Orphaned bash, tail, sleep and node processes are flagged. Only clearly dead ones of ours are reaped.
3. A graph goes on the Live card.
These land as three small merges.
